cards.card_text: Then they read off everything this place is NOT: not grain, not figs, not vines, not pomegranates, "…and there is no water to drink!" Next, Moses and Aaron leave the assembly, go to the entrance to the Tent of Meeting and fall facedown.
cards.verse_text: It is not a place of grain, figs, vines, or pomegranates—and there is no water to drink!” Then Moses and Aaron went from the presence of the assembly to the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.

cards.card_text: It's a land of wheat, barley, vines, fig trees and pomegranates, a land of olive oil and honey.
cards.verse_text: a land of wheat, barley, vines, fig trees, and pomegranates; a land of olive oil and honey;

cards.card_text: Meanwhile, Saul is staying under the pomegranate tree in Migron, on the outskirts of Gibeah.

cards.card_text: Out front, he makes two pillars, thirty-five cubits high together, with chainwork on top and a hundred pomegranates fastened into it.
cards.verse_text: He made a hundred pomegranates and fastened them into the chainwork.
cards.snippet: He made a hundred pomegranates and fastened them into the chainwork.

cards.card_text: Huram, the craftsman the king of Tyre sent (2 Chronicles 2:13), finishes the work: the pillars, the network, four hundred pomegranates, the stands, the basins, the Sea and its oxen, the pots, shovels and forks, all polished bronze cast in clay molds on the plain of the Jordan.
cards.verse_text: So Huram finished the work that he had undertaken for King Solomon in the house of God: the two pillars; the two bowl-shaped capitals atop the pillars; the two sets of network covering both bowls of the capitals atop the pillars; the four hundred pomegranates for the two sets of network (two rows of pomegranates for each network covering both the bowl-shaped capitals atop the pillars); the stands; the basins on the stands; the Sea; the twelve oxen underneath the Sea; and the pots, shovels, meat forks, and all the other articles.
cards.snippet: …covering both bowls of the capitals atop the pillars; the four hundred pomegranates for the two sets of network (two rows of pomegranates for each…

cards.card_text: Friend, the BEST compliment I've ever given anybody is “nice batch.” But he's not done: her lips are like a scarlet ribbon, her mouth is lovely, and her brow behind her veil is like a slice of pomegranate.
cards.verse_text: Your brow behind your veil is like a slice of pomegranate.
cards.snippet: Your brow behind your veil is like a slice of pomegranate.

cards.card_text: Then he fills that garden with an orchard of pomegranates and the finest spices, from henna and nard to cinnamon, myrrh and aloes.
cards.verse_text: Your branches are an orchard of pomegranates with the choicest of fruits, with henna and nard, with nard and saffron, with calamus and cinnamon, with every kind of frankincense tree, with myrrh and aloes, with all the finest spices.

cards.card_text: At the walnut grove, the speaker went to see if the vines were ___ or the pomegranates were in bloom.
cards.verse_text: I went down to the walnut grove to see the blossoms of the valley, to see if the vines were budding or the pomegranates were in bloom.
cards.snippet: …of the valley, to see if the vines were budding or the pomegranates were in bloom.

cards.card_text: The Chaldeans strip the house of the LORD: the two huge bronze pillars with their bronze pomegranates, the stands, the bronze Sea King Solomon made, and the bowls and lampstands of bronze, gold and silver.
cards.verse_text: The bronze capital atop one pillar was five cubits high, with a network of bronze pomegranates all around.
cards.snippet: …atop one pillar was five cubits high, with a network of bronze pomegranates all around.

cards.card_text: The whole harvest of the field has perished, and then Joel walks us through the orchard: the grapevine, the fig, the pomegranate, the palm, the apple.
cards.verse_text: The grapevine is dried up, and the fig tree is withered; the pomegranate, palm, and apple—all the trees of the orchard—are withered.
cards.snippet: The grapevine is dried up, and the fig tree is withered; the pomegranate, palm, and apple—all the trees of the orchard—are withered.

cards.card_text: True or false: the vine, the fig, the pomegranate and the olive tree have already yielded fruit.
cards.verse_text: The vine, the fig, the pomegranate, and the olive tree have not yet yielded fruit.
cards.snippet: The vine, the fig, the pomegranate, and the olive tree have not yet yielded fruit.
